tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rdo rje 'od gsal bzhugs so// shrī nā tha na ma mi/ dpal gur gyi mgon po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ gnas ji ltar 'tshams par sa stegs la zhi ba'i thabs kye rdor bzhin chu tshon gyis bris pa'i dbus su nas nag gi tshom bu lha grangs dang mnyam pa bkod la/ kha khyer steng du lci ba brtsig shar lhor zan gyi ting lo ras mar bcas pa gzhag rang kha shar du bltas pa'i mdun du me yol/ rdo rje dril bu nang mchod/ dgang gzar blug rnams spyi dang mthun/ g.yas su rang ngos nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas yam shing / mar/ yungs kar/ 'bras/ zas mchog so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dur ba/ ku sha rnams dang / g.yon nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga/ gtor ma gsum mam lnga gang rung bshams/ me spor ba'i spor me yang sta gon bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed mgon po dpa' rkyang sgrub thabs ltar bsgom/ nang mchod byin rlabs gtor ma ltar byas nas rdo rje'i rtses thab dang yo byad thams cad la gtor/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang / bsreg rdzas rnams bgegs dang bar chod zhi ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang / oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ oṃ a swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ dharma ra ṇi brjod cing rol mo dkrol/ /thab khung mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba/ kha khyer mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan pa'i phyi rol tu stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje can/

bud shing brtsigs pa las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur/ me 'bar ba'i nang / dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug las mgon po/ g.yon du e ka dza ṭi'i lto bar lha mo/ las mgon ru 'dren rnams gtor chog ltar bskyed/ dur khrod du lha klu phyogs skyong zhing skyong / gza' rgyu skar 'jigs byed rgyal chen/ gzhan yang snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snyi nga kha nas 'od 'phros pas mgon po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po kun༞ lha mo༞ las mgon kun bshags sogs kyis spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pa res dbu brgyan/ de nas yi ge bdun pa brjod cing spor me de sbar thab la g.yas skor gsum byas nas shar lho'i ting lo sbar/ yam shing gzhan dang bcas nas mar blug gzar gsum gyis me gso/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi ljags la rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan zhing / dgang gzar blug gzar gyi kha la raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ yi ge bdun pa gsum gyis byon zan mar dbul/ dgang blug kha sbyar nas thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing / oṃ ma hā kā lā ya sa pa ri wā ra bdag gi sdig sgrib las ngan dam tshig nyams chags sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas yam shing mar gang 'tshams phul rjes yungs kar la bcu cha'i grangs bzung /

gzhan bsreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa re skabs gang bder dbul/ bar bar du yam shing dang mar gyis me gso zhing / mthar mar gyis gang ba'i sbyin sreg gsum dbul/ 'di thams cad la 'bul sngags yi ge bdun pa spel tshig gong ltar kho nas dbul lo/ /gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ so so'i sngags kyis phul nas/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ bstod pa/ phrin las 'chol ba rnams rgyas bsdus gang 'os bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs bzod gsol/ mdun gyi mgon po lha brgyad rang la thim zhing gzhan rnams badz+ra muḥ rang gi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum/ dge ba bsngo/ smon lam/ bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /yo byad gzhan bsdu zhing / me ma shi bar mi reg grub rjes thal ba chu bor dor/ zhes 'di nyung la dgyes rnams la/ /ma nor don tshang go bde'i ngag /gsal bar bkod pa'i dge ba des/ /bgegs dang bar chad zhi gyur cig /sa skya lo tsās bris pa'o/ /drag po'i sbyin sreg logs na yod/ /e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
